title: Deleted Edges Reappear On Zoom
description: When deleting selected edges in puzzle2d, edges disappear but reappear after zoom. Root cause: reconcileHostDeclarativeSceneEdges restores edges from hostDeclarativeSceneDescriptor when scene edge count drops below declarativeSceneEdgeExpectation without updating the snapshot after user deletes.
summary: Edge delete now propagates to all puzzle2d panes: applyStructuralRemoveSilent prunes host declarative snapshots so peers do not reconcile edges back; authoritative wasm drains commit deletes to peers via commitAuthoritativeStructuralDelete; playground applyStructuralDelete calls puzzle2dSyncFixtureDescriptorToAllAuthoringPeers after edge/node removal. Added peer edge-delete regression test.
